name: Singapore American School
summary: Large US-curriculum campus in Woodlands with extensive co-curriculars and strong college counselling — geography is part of the admissions decision.
body: SAS is one of Singapore’s largest international schools, offering an American pathway from early childhood through high school with AP options and extensive co-curriculars. The Woodlands campus is a full-day geographic commitment — families often live north/west or accept longer drives from central belts. That housing lock-in is the practical differentiator vs Portsdown / Bukit Timah / East Coast campuses. Waitlists and admissions cycles are competitive for popular grades; start early if your move is package-timed, and ask HR about any corporate nomination pathways in writing. Tour with commute maths in hand, not just the theatre and pool.
waitlistNotes: Plan 6–12 months ahead for peak grades; sibling priority and corporate nomination policies vary — verify in writing.
